priogridR: Tools for working with PRIO-GRID data

Source: R/priogridR_package.R
priogridR-package.Rd

Convenience functions for grid indexing, coordinate conversion, geometry, spatial neighborhoods, weights, lags, distances, buffer summaries, validation, panel completion, safe joins, plotting, and converting common spatial data formats to configurable PRIO-GRID rasters and data frames.
